{
  "edges": [
    {
      "fromKey": "n-ufqg50",
      "toKey": "n-11kmdda",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The pressure drop at P-R (RHOB) while upstream P-U remained stable indicates a localized issue downstream of the North gallery or within the RHOB distribution path. The origin remains unknown due to lack of data on intermediate valves, flow values, and alarm input mapping.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the pressure drop had occurred upstream of P-R, both P-U and P-R would have shown a simultaneous decrease.",
      "competingExplanation": "A failure at the receiving equipment (RHOB) could also cause localized loss without affecting upstream points. Evidence does not distinguish between distribution system fault or local valve/equipment failure.",
      "evidenceGap": "Missing records: intermediate pressure readings, flow values, and alarm input mapping for P-R."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-17qciec",
      "toKey": "n-11kmdda",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The shift log records 'boundary preparation in progress' but does not identify the point of interruption or valve states. This lack of detail contributes to uncertainty about whether a procedural gap (e.g., missing isolation) caused the event.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the boundary had been fully released and valves confirmed closed, a distribution system fault would be more likely.",
      "competingExplanation": "The event could have occurred despite proper procedures if an external factor (e.g., upstream supply fluctuation) caused it. Evidence does not confirm procedural compliance or valve states.",
      "evidenceGap": "Missing records: documented confirmation of boundary release, valve positions at time of interruption."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1lde5sa",
      "toKey": "n-11kmdda",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "No evidence exists that Utilities and RHOB confirmed understanding of the air-low alarm. This communication gap may have delayed response or obscured root cause identification.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [
        "q-8irrr9"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If confirmation had occurred, the team might have identified whether the alarm was a false positive or required immediate action.",
      "competingExplanation": "The event could still be caused by equipment failure even with perfect communication. Evidence does not establish that lack of confirmation directly contributed to the interruption.",
      "evidenceGap": "Missing records: documentation of alarm acknowledgment, verbal confirmations, or handoff notes."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1oedffs",
      "toKey": "n-11kmdda",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The specific communication medium (radio, phone, face-to-face) is not documented. Unclear or delayed messaging could have contributed to the event's impact.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "story-release:323756f5-dbe1-4650-9121-d583b3f97d77:bq-1fanm2w"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If a more reliable communication channel had been used, the team might have responded faster or clarified the issue.",
      "competingExplanation": "The event could still be caused by equipment failure even with optimal communication. Evidence does not establish that poor communication directly contributed to the interruption.",
      "evidenceGap": "Missing records: logs of communications attempted during the incident."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1x7dd07",
      "toKey": "n-11kmdda",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Environmental conditions such as noise or distance affecting message clarity are not documented. These factors could have hindered effective communication during the incident.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "story-release:323756f5-dbe1-4650-9121-d583b3f97d77:bq-1fanm2w"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If environmental conditions had been favorable, communication might have been clearer and faster.",
      "competingExplanation": "The event could still be caused by equipment failure even in ideal environmental conditions. Evidence does not establish that poor environment directly contributed to the interruption.",
      "evidenceGap": "Missing records: site layout diagrams showing noise sources or distance between teams."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-13isny6",
      "toKey": "n-11kmdda",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The alarm's occurrence time, acknowledgment time and export time may differ. Timing discrepancies could have led to delayed response or misinterpretation of the event.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "d838e866-dc34-4814-8dad-3b97d0353f05#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If alarm times were synchronized and accurate, the team might have responded more quickly.",
      "competingExplanation": "The event could still be caused by equipment failure even with precise timing. Evidence does not establish that time discrepancies directly contributed to the interruption.",
      "evidenceGap": "Missing records: detailed alarm logs showing occurrence vs acknowledgment times."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1nupisc",
      "toKey": "n-11kmdda",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "An empty form field records no value; the reason it is empty requires other evidence. Missing documentation could indicate procedural gaps or oversight.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "d838e866-dc34-4814-8dad-3b97d0353f05#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If form fields had been completed, missing information might have been identified earlier.",
      "competingExplanation": "The event could still be caused by equipment failure even with complete documentation. Evidence does not establish that empty fields directly contributed to the interruption.",
      "evidenceGap": "Missing records: explanations for blank fields in work orders or logs."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-85pdam",
      "toKey": "n-11kmdda",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Maintenance acceptance signature was not yet signed at notification time. This suggests the work boundary had not been formally released, which could have contributed to confusion or lack of coordination.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the maintenance had been formally accepted, procedures might have ensured proper isolation and communication.",
      "competingExplanation": "The event could still be caused by equipment failure even with formal acceptance. Evidence does not establish that unsigned signature directly contributed to the interruption.",
      "evidenceGap": "Missing records: documentation of why signatures were pending or how work proceeded without them."
    }
  ],
  "decision": {
    "summary": "The incident involved a localized instrument-air pressure loss at RHOB (P-R) while upstream supply remained stable. The origin remains unknown due to insufficient data on intermediate valves and flow values. Contributing factors include lack of documented confirmation between teams, unclear communication methods, environmental conditions affecting messaging, timing discrepancies in alarm handling, incomplete documentation (empty fields), and pending maintenance acceptance signatures.",
    "evidenceUsed": [
      "fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1",
      "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1",
      "q-8irrr9",

      "d838e866-dc34-4814-8dad-3b97d0353f05#1",
      "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"
    ],
    "unknowns": [
      "Exact origin of pressure loss (source, distribution system, or equipment)",
      "Whether simultaneous low-pressure events occurred at other locations",
      "Specific cause of air-low indication at RHOB P-R",
      "Reason for empty form fields and pending maintenance signatures"
    ],
    "alternatives": [
      "Upstream supply fluctuation caused localized pressure drop.",
      "Local valve failure or equipment malfunction within RHOB distribution path."
    ],
    "confidence": 0.65

]
